scenes.q: If your biggest sale went live today, would your website hold?

caption:
3.5 billion requests hit one ticket site in a day.

On 15 Nov 2022, Eras Tour tickets went on sale. Ticketmaster said its system took 3.5 billion requests, four times its previous peak, and over 2 million tickets sold that day. It also said about 15% of interactions had issues, and the public sale was cancelled.

The demand was real. The site wasn't built for the crowd. If you run a shop or service in Namibia, a big sale or a rush of WhatsApp and online orders is the same test.

If your biggest sale went live today, would your website hold? DM us the word RUSH and we'll check it for you.

Sources: Ticketmaster, "The Eras Tour onsale explained" (19 Nov 2022); NBC News on the 3.5 billion requests and the cancelled public sale.
